INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail from scratch, landscape 16:9, approximately 1536x864 or larger, PNG. This is for バスケまとめ, article dated 2026.11.01.

STYLE: approved black-and-lime editorial sports illustration: charcoal black #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B dry-brush accents, off-white bold Japanese typography, forceful hand-drawn black ink outlines, visible brush strokes and restrained rough paper texture. This must look like a deliberate drawn ink illustration, NOT a photo, NOT photorealistic, not a 3D render. Few elements, ample separation, powerful legible typography.

SUBJECT: exactly ONE REAL basketball player, James Bell (ジェームズ・ベル), referenced from his current official Yokohama B-Corsairs profile portrait at https://b-corsairs.com/team/players/detail/id=23241?PlayerID=51000172 (portrait https://b-corsairs.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1791970457/files/user/team/2026-27/31_BELL.jpg), visually checked for appearance. Depict his actual characteristics: dark brown skin, close-cropped very short tightly curled black hair with a rounded hairline, broad oval face, broad nose, clear alert almond-shaped eyes, full thick black beard covering the lower cheeks and jaw and extending below chin, moustache connected to beard, sturdy muscular shoulders and strong athletic build. Keep these features recognizable in an ink drawing, with light face planes so the face is not lost in shadow. Use the CURRENT short-haired official portrait, NOT older long braids/dreadlocks. Do not create a generic fictional player.
Draw him on the LEFT side in an energetic low dribbling drive, torso leaning diagonally forward, knees bent, one clearly drawn hand controlling an orange basketball near hip-to-knee height, other arm naturally bent. Head, ball, elbows and both hands fully within the canvas, hands anatomically coherent, no duplicated fingers. Intentional mid-thigh framing is okay. Face in readable front three-quarter view looking toward the right, not obscured by arms. Plain sleeveless dark-navy basketball jersey and shorts with fine off-white trim, NO jersey writing, NO number, NO logos, NO sponsors. No other people. Use broad diagonal lime brush strokes behind the player to imply movement, without crowd, arena specificity, or identifiable event.

LAYOUT: player fills left 45 percent, headline occupies right 50 percent; clear 5 percent outer margins. Do not copy the composition of a jump-shot illustration. Keep image and text from colliding. Text safe inside all edges. Right headline stacked in clean, extremely bold Japanese type with slight ink texture.
EXACT VISIBLE TEXT ONLY (preserve Japanese characters, no additional text):
Top-left small: 「バスケまとめ」
Top-right small: 「2026.11.01」
Right main headline line 1, off-white: 「神奈川」
Right main headline line 2, off-white: 「ダービー」
Right main headline line 3, largest lime: 「第2戦へ」
Right below headline, medium off-white: 「川崎 × 横浜BC」
Right lower small but comfortably readable off-white: 「出場メンバー未確認」
Bottom-left in its own clear dark space, readable off-white: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Bottom-left on same baseline next to AI label: 「イメージ」

EDITORIAL FACTS AND LIMITATIONS: content is based ONLY on supplied fixed article source.html/source.txt. The article reviews Game 1 and looks ahead to Game 2. Game 2 lineup and injury status are unconfirmed. The reference photo is ONLY for the real player's likeness, never pasted or copied as a photograph. This scene is an invented illustrative basketball movement, not a recreation of any actual match event and not a claim that Bell will appear in Game 2. No claims about any player's points, performance, selection, participation, win or loss. No personal name in visible text. No scores, start time, league names or logos. Preserve the uncertainty text exactly. No team or league logos, sponsor marks, photographic backgrounds or official photo compositing. The only orange is the ball. Produce one polished finished thumbnail.

ONE ALLOWED REVISION
Edit the provided finished thumbnail ONCE to fix ONLY framing. Preserve the exact Japanese text, all letters and numbers, the James Bell likeness with close-cropped hair and full beard, the navy blank uniform, ink-brush illustration style, color palette, right-half typography and footer AI label.

Restore the previously clipped portion of the hand and ball naturally. Each hand has five anatomically coherent digits. The player can intentionally continue below the frame at mid-thigh.
